name: Regression: Locked layer blocks painting tools, displays warning toast, and preserves history buffers
description: Verify locking an active artwork layer blocks destructive painting attempts, fires an informative warning toast notification, and prevents empty or corrupt strokes from polluting the history stack.

planSteps.description: Click on the center drawing canvas to paint a pixel
Click the Layers tab button in the right inspector panel
Click the lock button on the active layer to lock it
Verify the active layer shows locked state in the inspector
Click on the center drawing canvas to attempt painting on the locked layer
Verify locked layer protection blocks edits on the canvas
Click the Undo button in the top header or press Ctrl+Z
Verify the undo action completes cleanly
